caption:
A slow lead doesn't just cost you the close.

It costs you the contact.

Research from MIT and InsideSales.com tracked how fast a lead's odds of answering collapse. Wait five minutes and your odds of reaching them drop by 10x.

Past ten minutes, most interested leads have already called a competitor or stopped checking their phone for your reply.

Two different curves punish delay: whether you reach the lead, and whether you win them once you do.

Black Arrow's own numbers land in the same place. Only 17% of service businesses respond within an hour. The ones who respond under five minutes close at nearly double the rate.
